alignments.note: Superscription 'A Psalm' answers to no morpheme; one added run (rule 2).
Verb takes auxiliary, subject pronoun and phrasal verb 'lift up' (rule 17/44).
Volitive frame 'Let me' belongs to the cohortative (rule 17); 'me' realizes its own person; light verb 'put to shame' heads on shame (rule 44).
Jussive frame 'Let' joins the verb, discontinuous around subject (rule 17/25).
'none' fuses universal kol with the negative; headed on the negative (rule 35).
Anarthrous participle takes supplied relative (rule 46); 'for' is the English verb's valency reaching the suffix (rule 44).
Light verb 'put to shame' heads on shame (rule 44).
Verb keeps auxiliaries and lexical phrase only; the explicit subject הַבּוֹגְדִים takes the fronted 'They' (rule 17).
Substantival article takes the supplied 'They ... that', discontinuous around the verb (rules 41, 25), headed on the pronoun.
Adverb rendered by the phrase 'without cause'; headed on the content word 'cause' (rule 24); 'without' is the competing head.

review_notes: Reconciliation: moved 'They' from s007 to the article s008, giving the article the discontinuous 'They ... that' under rule 41 (corpus: הַ → 'they that' in 51 units, headed on 'they'). Everything else as the verse pass returned it.

alignments.note: Copula joins the nominal predicate (rule 20); supplied 'the' on the construct (rule 29).
Object marker takes the 'For' the English verb needs to reach its object (rule 16, first family).
'tender mercies' for raḥamim; ASV writes 'mercies' alone for this word elsewhere, so 'tender' is the specifier and the head stays on mercies (rule 31); heading on 'tender' was available.
Prepositional predicate takes the construction-supplied copula 'have been' (rule 49).
'ever ... old' both realize ʿolam; headed on 'old', the word 'of old' turns on; 'ever' is the competing head.
Dative lamed rendered as bare object 'me' (rule 40).
Explicit subject pronoun takes its own 'thou'.
'For ... sake' is the preposition's fixed rendering, discontinuous (rule 25); headed on the content word 'sake' (rule 24).
Copula joins the first predicate adjective (rule 20), discontinuous.
ʿal-ken fused as 'Therefore'; headed on the governing first particle (rule 23/30).
Assimilated article; ASV writes no 'the' before justice (rule 12).
ASV writes no connective for the waw of the apodosis (rule 14).
Interrogative is the predicate and takes the copula (rule 20).
Deictic zeh after mi rendered by 'he' (rule 22); marking it unrepresented and the 'he' added was the competing reading.
Articleless attributive recast as relative keeps the 'that' (rule 41).
Relative supplied over an asyndetic finite clause with a written antecedent (rule 55).
Supplied 'the' on construct (rule 29); margin 'counsel/secret' read and set aside (rule 38).
Infinitive recast as finite clause with no word for the lamed (rule 52/40); margin read and set aside.
Supplied subject and modal belong to the infinitive (rule 52).
Reflexive 'thee' renders the verb's own sense (rule 44).
Light verb 'have mercy' heads on mercy; 'upon' is the verb's valency reaching the suffix (rule 44).
Volitive 'Oh' frame and subject pronoun belong to the imperative (rule 17).
Volitive frame 'Let me' belongs to the cohortative (rule 17); light verb heads on shame (rule 44).
Light verb 'take refuge' heads on refuge (rule 44).
Jussive frame 'Let' belongs to the verb, discontinuous around the subject (rule 17/25).
'for' is the English verb's valency reaching the suffix (rule 44).
